Step 1: Identify the event in question, which is the terrorist attacks on the United States on September 11, 2001.
Step 2: Review the findings of the bipartisan 9/11 Commission and law enforcement investigations, which concluded that the attacks were planned and executed by the militant Islamist terrorist organization Al-Qaeda, led by Osama bin Laden.
Step 3: Evaluate the given options against these historical facts. Options (A), (D), (E), and (F) represent conspiracy theories. Options (B) and (G) name foreign nations not responsible for the attacks. Option (C) correctly identifies Al-Qaeda as the perpetrator.
